title: Personal Services Plan — Unused Hours Rollover Allowance by Tier
content:
Two figures govern whether unused personal service hours of the Personal Services Plan carry into the next month: the number of months unused allotted hours carry forward before expiring, and the maximum unused hours carried into the next month.

| Tier | Months unused hours carry forward | Maximum hours carried into the next month |
|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 0 | 0 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 0 | 0 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 0 | 0 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 0 | 0 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 1 | 10 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 1 | 15 |

## Questions the table answers

**Which tiers carry unused hours forward at all?**
Only the Personal Services Premier Package and the Personal Services Concierge Package, each for 1 month. On every other tier the carry-forward period is 0 months and the cap is 0 hours.

**How many hours can carry over on the Premier Package?**
At most 10 hours into the next month; on the Concierge Package at most 15 hours.

**Hypothetical case.** A Premier Package plan that ends a month with 13 unused hours carries 10 hours into the next month, the cap of 10 hours being the lower figure; a Concierge Package plan with the same 13 unused hours carries all 13, which is below its cap of 15 hours.
